actions.action: Prune fully yellow, brown or dried lower/old leaves at the base of the stalk
Sanitize the cutting blade before pruning
Gradually move the plant into fuller sun on the balcony
Check soil and water thoroughly when top 2-3 inches are dry
Feed with balanced liquid fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in spring/summer
Inspect leaf undersides and stalk joints for spider mites, mealybugs and scale
Repot into a slightly larger container every 2-3 years or when root-bound
Bring the plant indoors before temperatures drop below 50°F

It advises keeping ragged green leaves, so the leaf removal that fixed the plant is incomplete and buried among general care tips, though nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plant.
